Jook Taproom, located in Indiranagar, is one of the most affordable restobars in the neighbourhood. It is easy to spot, and there is very little parking space available at the entrance. …

Great place for open air style dining, and has great view too! Veg food was great and fulfilling.. but the non-veg options were okay ish and not upto the mark.. Drinks were good and fair enough for the price it is priced at!! The staff were kind and really helpful too :)
